Using.description: List of Serilog sink assemblies to use

Default.description: Default minimum log level (Verbose, Debug, Information, Warning, Error, Fatal)

Override.description: Override minimum levels for specific namespaces

WriteTo.description: List of sinks to write logs to

Enrich.description: List of enrichers to add context to log events

AllowedHosts.description: Semicolon-separated list of allowed host headers. Use '*' to allow all hosts.

UseGoogleAsExternalProvider.description: Enable Google as an external authentication provider

AppHasLatinTranslation.description: Whether the application has Latin script translation support

EmailSender.description: Email address used to send verification emails during login or registration

UnhandledExceptionRecipients.description: Email addresses that will receive notifications when an unhandled exception occurs in production

SmtpHost.description: SMTP server hostname for sending emails (e.g., smtp.gmail.com)

SmtpPort.description: SMTP server port (e.g., 587 for TLS, 465 for SSL)

JwtIssuer.description: The issuer claim for JWT tokens (typically your API URL)

JwtAudience.description: The audience claim for JWT tokens (typically your API URL)

ClockSkewMinutes.description: Allowed clock skew in minutes for token validation. Set to 1 minute because the frontend sends requests exactly when the token expires.

ConnectionString.description: Database connection string. Configure in user secrets with: dotnet user-secrets set "AppSettings:Spiderly.Shared:ConnectionString" "YourConnectionString"

RequestsLimitNumber.description: Maximum number of requests allowed within the rate limit window

RequestsLimitWindow.description: Rate limit window duration in seconds

JwtIssuer.description: The issuer claim for JWT tokens (typically your API URL)

JwtAudience.description: The audience claim for JWT tokens (typically your API URL)

ClockSkewMinutes.description: Allowed clock skew in minutes for token validation. Set to 1 minute because the frontend sends requests exactly when the token expires.

AccessTokenExpiration.description: Access token expiration time in minutes

RefreshTokenExpiration.description: Refresh token expiration time in minutes (e.g., 1440 = 24 hours)

VerificationTokenExpiration.description: Verification token expiration time in minutes (used for email verification)

NumberOfFailedLoginAttemptsInARowToDisab.description: Number of consecutive failed login attempts before the user account is disabled

AllowTheUseOfAppWithDifferentIpAddresses.description: Allow users to access the application from different IP addresses

AllowedBrowsersForTheSingleUser.description: Maximum number of concurrent browser sessions allowed for a single user

GoogleClientId.description: Google OAuth 2.0 Client ID for Google Sign-In integration

ExcelContentType.description: MIME content type for Excel file exports

OnlyAdminCanAddUsers.description: Restrict user registration to administrators only
